Affordia Health

About Us Healthcare in China, Made More Accessible Affordia Health helps international clients access affordable, high-quality healthcare in China with greater choice, faster access, and professional support throughout their medical journey.

We primarily serve clients travelling from Europe, the United States, Africa, and other international markets who are looking for an alternative to high treatment costs, long waiting times, or limited access to specialised medical care in their home countries.
Our purpose is simple:
Make quality healthcare in China easier to access, easier to understand, and easier to navigate.
We Start With You Every medical journey is different.
That is why Affordia Health does not begin with a hospital. We begin with the client's individual situation, requirements, preferences, budget, and desired level of support.
We identify suitable healthcare options within the regions where we can provide reliable local assistance and help clients navigate the available possibilities.
Our goal is not simply to find a hospital.
Our goal is to help create a medical journey that combines appropriate healthcare access with the practical support an international client needs while travelling in China.
Independent by Design Affordia Health currently operates as an independent service provider.
We are not tied to a predetermined hospital network, and we do not automatically direct every client to the same institutions.
We search for suitable options according to the individual case, available treatment capacity, medical specialisation, location, accessibility, cost, and the support we can provide in that region.
If Affordia Health establishes a commercial partnership with a hospital or healthcare provider for a particular service in the future, that relationship may be disclosed transparently where relevant.
Our clients should understand why an option is being presented to them.
Quality Matters For hospital-based treatment, our focus is on China's Grade 3A (Tier 3A ) hospitals, representing the highest level within China's hospital classification system.
However, a hospital's classification is only the beginning.

Different Grade 3A hospitals have different strengths. A major comprehensive hospital may provide excellent general tertiary care, while another institution may have a highly specialised department with extensive experience in a particular procedure or condition.
For this reason, we consider not only the hospital itself but also the relevant speciality, department, available expertise, accessibility, and suitability for the individual case.

Affordable Does Not Mean Lower Standards The name Affordia Health reflects an important part of our mission: helping people explore healthcare that may be financially more accessible without making affordability the only criterion.
Treatment costs in China can, depending on the procedure, hospital, department, treatment complexity and level of service, differ substantially from those in other countries.
We therefore do not promise a fixed percentage of savings.
Instead, we help clients understand the available options and expected costs before they decide whether travelling to China makes sense for them.
Affordability matters. Quality matters more. The right solution requires both.
More Than Hospital Access Travelling abroad for healthcare involves much more than arranging an appointment.

A client may need help communicating with a hospital, preparing documentation, understanding the process, arranging accommodation, organising transportation, navigating an unfamiliar city, communicating in Chinese, or simply having someone local to contact when something unexpected happens.
Affordia Health can provide support throughout this journey.

Depending on the services selected, this may include hospital and clinic selection, treatment coordination, document preparation, travel assistance, visa preparation support, accommodation assistance, airport pickup, interpretation and local assistance during the client's stay.
Clients can choose individual services or request support for their complete medical journey.
You choose the level of support you need.
Local Support in China One of the foundations of Affordia Health is our local presence.
Where our services are available, we aim to ensure that international clients are not left to navigate China entirely on their own.

Depending on the selected service, our local support can begin when the client arrives at the airport and continue through transportation, accommodation, hospital visits, interpretation and practical assistance during the stay.
If an unexpected practical problem occurs during a client's medical journey, our local team can remain a point of contact within the scope of the services we provide.
You may travel far for healthcare. You should not have to navigate the journey alone.
You Remain in Control Affordia Health is a service and coordination company.
We do not provide medical diagnosis or treatment, and we do not replace doctors, hospitals or other licensed healthcare professionals.
Medical decisions and medical services remain between the client and the healthcare provider.
We also believe clients should maintain control over their own journey.
Wherever practicable, clients pay hospitals and other thirdparty providers directly. Treatment payments do not need to pass through Affordia Health simply because we helped arrange access.
Clients can purchase their own flights and retain control over their travel arrangements and healthcare expenditure.
Affordia Health charges for the services Affordia Health provides.
This separation keeps our role clear: we help clients research, organise, coordinate and navigate their medical journey while healthcare professionals remain responsible for healthcare.
International by Nature. Personal by Design.

Our clients can communicate with us internationally through familiar communication channels, including WhatsApp, while communication and local coordination in China can also be supported through WeChat.
Initial consultation with Affordia Health is free.
We first listen to what the client needs and determine whether and how we may be able to assist.
If the client decides to proceed, the required services, expected fees and next steps can be agreed before the journey begins.
There is no requirement to purchase a complete package.
Start with one service or choose a complete medical journey. Add only the services you need.
Our Mission To make high-quality healthcare in China more accessible to international clients through independent access, transparent choice, professional coordination and reliable local support.
Affordia Health exists to bridge the distance between a person looking for healthcare and the opportunities available within China's healthcare system.
Your needs come first. The journey is built around them.
Affordia Care
Affordia Care Global Online Prevention & Long- Term Health Support You Don't Have to Travel to China to Access Affordia Care.
Affordia Care is a global online service for people who want to take a longer-term approach to their health.
It is designed for people who want to:

prevent health problems where possible, understand potential health risks, explore appropriate non-surgical options, improve their lifestyle, receive access to online consultations with qualified Chinese healthcare professionals, explore Traditional Chinese Medicine where appropriate, or improve their long-term health strategy after treatment or surgery.
You can participate from your own country.
Affordia Care comes to you online.
Health Is More Than Treatment Modern medicine can do extraordinary things.
When surgery is necessary, it can solve problems that could not otherwise be treated effectively.
But treatment of an immediate medical problem and longterm health management are not always the same thing.
A procedure may address a structural or immediate clinical problem while other relevant factors may still deserve attention.
Depending on the condition, these may include:
physical activity, body weight, nutrition, sleep, stress, smoking, alcohol, work environment, physical conditioning, metabolic factors, or other individual risks.
Not every condition is caused by lifestyle and not every recurrence can be prevented.
But where modifiable risk factors exist, understanding them can become an important part of long-term care.
Treat the Problem.
Understand the Risks.
Work on What Can Be Changed.
Prevention Before Problems Become Bigger Healthcare should not begin only when a person needs an operation.
Affordia Care encourages earlier attention.
This may mean:

understanding risk factors, recognising persistent changes, maintaining appropriate preventive examinations, improving everyday habits, seeking professional advice earlier, and monitoring known problems over time.
Prevention cannot eliminate every disease.
But appropriate prevention can help reduce certain health risks and identify some problems earlier.
Earlier understanding can create more options.
Explore Non-Surgical Options Some people are told that they may eventually need a procedure but want to understand whether appropriate conservative options exist first.
Others simply want another professional perspective before making a major decision.
Affordia Care can help coordinate access to qualified professionals who can evaluate available options.

Depending on the condition, appropriate non-surgical management may involve conventional medicine, rehabilitation, physiotherapy, lifestyle modification, monitoring or other professionally recommended approaches.
Traditional Chinese Medicine may also be explored where appropriate.
The objective is not:
“Avoid surgery at all costs.” The objective is:
Understand Your Options Before You Decide.
When surgery is medically necessary, Affordia Care should never be used to delay urgent or necessary treatment.

Online Consultation With Chinese Healthcare Professionals Affordia Care can connect clients internationally with qualified healthcare professionals in China for online consultation where such consultation is appropriate and legally available.
Depending on the client's needs and professional involved, consultations may explore:

existing health concerns, prevention, lifestyle factors, long-term health management, conservative treatment possibilities, Traditional Chinese Medicine, post-treatment support, or another professional perspective.
The healthcare professional — not Affordia Care — remains responsible for their professional medical advice.
Traditional Chinese Medicine China has developed medical traditions over thousands of years alongside its modern healthcare system.
Affordia Care can provide access to qualified Traditional Chinese Medicine professionals for clients who wish to explore this field.
Depending on the professional assessment, TCM approaches may include:
Chinese herbal medicine, acupuncture-related planning, dietary guidance, movement practices, and other traditional approaches.
Chinese herbal medicine is not simply a collection of products to purchase online.
Herbs can have biological effects, side effects and interactions with medications.
For that reason, herbal approaches should be considered with appropriate professional guidance.
Traditional does not mean risk-free. Professional assessment matters.
Before Surgery If you are considering surgery, Affordia Care can help you explore appropriate questions before making your decision.
For example:
Are appropriate conservative options available?
Have relevant lifestyle or physical factors been considered?
Would another professional opinion be useful?
Are there risk factors that could be improved before treatment?
What should be considered during recovery?
The answer may still be surgery.
If so, the purpose of the consultation is not to fight that conclusion.
It is to help you make a better-informed decision.
After Surgery Treatment Can End. Prevention Should Continue.
A successful procedure does not necessarily mean that every relevant long-term risk has disappeared.
Where appropriate, recovery can become the beginning of a new prevention strategy.
Affordia Care can help clients explore:
recovery routines, appropriate physical activity, nutrition, weight management, sleep, stress, rehabilitation, follow-up, and other modifiable factors relevant to their situation.
This is not about replacing postoperative instructions from the treating doctor.
Those instructions come first.
Affordia Care can help build a longer-term strategy around them.
Post-Treatment Reconsultation After an operation or other significant treatment, clients may want to reassess their situation.
What has changed?
What still requires attention?
Which risks remain?
Which habits should change?
What should be monitored?
When should another professional assessment take place?
Affordia Care can coordinate an online reconsultation and help structure the next stage of the client's long-term health journey.
Recovery Is a Phase. Long- Term Health Continues.
Lifestyle Is Not One Product Healthy living has become an enormous commercial industry.
Expensive food.
Supplements.
Vitamins.
Wearables.
Fitness products.
Wellness programmes.
Some may be useful in appropriate circumstances.
But buying one expensive healthy product does not automatically create a healthy life.
Health develops through patterns.
What you repeatedly eat.
How you move.
How you sleep.
How you work.
How you manage stress.
Which risks you expose yourself to.
Whether you smoke.
How much alcohol you consume.
Whether you attend appropriate examinations.
And how consistently you follow professional advice when you have an existing medical problem.
Health Is Built by Patterns, Not Individual Purchases.
An Individual Approach Two people of the same age can have completely different health priorities.
Affordia Care therefore does not begin with a universal lifestyle programme.
It begins with the individual.
Depending on the service, relevant factors may include:
age, health history, current concerns, existing diagnoses, medication, family history, nutrition, physical activity, sleep, work, stress, personal goals, and other relevant circumstances.
Qualified professionals can then determine what information and recommendations are appropriate within their professional scope.
Long-Term Online Cooperation Affordia Care is not intended only for one conversation.
Clients who want continued support may choose a longerterm relationship.
This may include:

Initial Consultation ↓ Individual Health Priorities ↓ Professional Recommendations ↓ Lifestyle Strategy ↓ Monitoring ↓ Follow-Up Consultation ↓ Adjustment ↓ Continued Prevention The frequency and type of professional consultation depends on the individual situation.
Monitor What Matters You do not need to obsess over every number your body produces.
Monitoring should have a purpose.
Where appropriate, qualified professionals may recommend following particular indicators, symptoms, habits or examination results.
The objective is to understand whether the chosen approach is helping and whether something has changed enough to require professional reassessment.
Monitor. Understand.
Adjust.
Mental Wellbeing Long-term health includes mental wellbeing.
Sleep, chronic stress, anxiety, emotional strain and other psychological factors can affect everyday functioning and quality of life.
Affordia Care can help clients access appropriate professional support when needed.
Serious or persistent mental-health concerns should be assessed by appropriately qualified mental-health professionals.
Families and Children Prevention can begin early.
Affordia Care can help families access professional guidance concerning healthy routines, nutrition, physical activity, sleep, development and other appropriate preventive considerations.
We do not promise to make children immune to illness or prevent allergies.
The objective is to support healthy development, recognise concerns appropriately and help families obtain qualified advice when needed.
Prevention at Every Age There is no age at which prevention suddenly becomes irrelevant.
At 20, prevention may mean building good foundations.
At 40, it may mean identifying accumulating risk factors.
At 60, it may mean preserving health, mobility and independence.
At 80, appropriate prevention and monitoring may still contribute to quality of life.
Prevention Has No Expiration Date.
You Don't Need to Be an Affordia Health Travel Client Affordia Care is available as a separate service.
You do not need to:
travel to China, book a Chinese hospital, purchase a medical journey, or undergo treatment abroad.
You can live in Europe, Africa, North America, South America or another supported region and use appropriate Affordia Care services online.
The service is global. The relationship is digital.
And If You Eventually Need More Sometimes prevention and conservative management are enough.
Sometimes they are not.
If further diagnostics, specialist assessment or treatment becomes necessary, Affordia Health can help the client explore additional healthcare options.
Where China becomes appropriate, the wider Affordia Health infrastructure can support:
hospital selection, specialist access, medical coordination, travel, interpretation, local assistance, and the complete medical journey.
Affordia Care therefore does not promise that every problem can be solved online.
It helps you understand when online support is enough — and when the next level of healthcare should begin.
Affordia Care Is Not Emergency Medicine Affordia Care is designed for prevention, long-term support, professional consultation and appropriate exploration of healthcare options.
It is not an emergency medical service.
Urgent or potentially life-threatening symptoms require immediate assessment through appropriate local emergency or healthcare services.
Do not delay urgent medical care while waiting for an Affordia Care consultation.
Our Philosophy We do not believe health begins with surgery.
We do not believe it ends after surgery.
And we do not believe healthy living can be purchased in a single product.
We believe long-term health deserves:
Understanding.
Prevention.
Professional guidance.
Individualisation.
Consistency.
Monitoring.
Adaptation.

Explore appropriate non-surgical options. Access Chinese healthcare expertise online. Understand your risks. Improve what can be improved. Continue prevention after treatment. Build healthier patterns for the long term.

Aftercare & Recovery
Healthcare
Aftercare & Recovery Treatment Is Not the End of the Journey A healthcare journey does not necessarily end when a procedure is completed or when a client leaves the hospital.
Recovery can be one of the most important stages of the entire process.
Depending on the treatment, recovery may involve:

follow-up consultations, rehabilitation, physiotherapy, wound or mobility management, medication monitoring, rest, nutrition, gradual return to activity, additional examinations, or longer-term lifestyle changes.
Affordia Health can help clients coordinate the practical parts of this stage.
Treatment Solves the Immediate Problem.
Recovery Builds the Next Step.
Recovery Starts Before You Leave the Hospital Before leaving the healthcare provider, clients should understand the relevant discharge and follow-up instructions given by their medical team.
Depending on the case, this may include:
medication instructions, physical restrictions, wound care, follow-up appointments, warning signs, rehabilitation recommendations, dietary instructions, and return-to-activity guidance.
These medical instructions come from the treating healthcare professionals.
Affordia Health can assist with understanding the practical journey around them.
Affordia Does Not Replace Postoperative Medical Care Affordia Health does not independently determine:

how a wound should be treated, which medication should be used, when a client should stop medication, when exercise should begin, whether a complication is developing, or whether further medical treatment is necessary.
These are healthcare decisions.
They remain with qualified healthcare professionals.
Our role is to help connect the client with the appropriate services and coordinate the practical elements of recovery.
Follow-Up Coordination After treatment, a client may need further contact with the hospital or specialist.
Affordia Health can help coordinate:
follow-up appointments, online follow-up consultations, communication with the treating provider, additional examinations, medical document coordination, and other agreed follow-up services.
Where the client has already returned home, follow-up may sometimes be coordinated remotely where clinically appropriate.
Recovery in China Some clients may need or prefer to remain in China for a period after treatment.
Depending on the selected services and healthcare recommendations, Affordia Health may assist with:
suitable accommodation, local transportation, hospital follow-up visits, interpretation, practical daily assistance, rehabilitation coordination, and preparation for the return journey.
The required level of support depends on the individual case.
Returning Home Returning home should be planned according to the client's medical condition and professional medical advice.
The treating healthcare provider should determine whether the client is medically fit to travel.
Affordia Health may assist with the practical preparation of the return journey but does not independently determine medical fitness to fly or travel.
Medical Clearance Comes From Healthcare Professionals.

Recovery Does Not Have to Continue in China A major advantage of the Affordia Health network is that recovery services do not necessarily need to be provided in the same country where treatment occurred.

Treatment in China ↓ Return to Europe ↓ Rehabilitation in Slovakia ↓ Physiotherapy Near Home ↓ Online Follow-Up ↓ Affordia Care This can allow the client to combine specialised treatment abroad with practical long-term recovery closer to home.
Rehabilitation Some procedures require structured rehabilitation.
Affordia Health can help identify and coordinate suitable rehabilitation providers within the developing Affordia Healthcare Partner network.
Depending on the client's needs, rehabilitation may include:

physiotherapy, mobility programmes, musculoskeletal rehabilitation, neurological rehabilitation, postoperative rehabilitation, cardiac rehabilitation, respiratory rehabilitation, or other professionally supervised programmes.
The appropriate rehabilitation plan must be determined by qualified healthcare professionals.
Medical Spas and Thermal Recovery For suitable clients, recovery may also include professionally supervised medical spa or thermal programmes.
Affordia Health is developing relationships with healthcare, rehabilitation and thermal spa providers, including potential partners in Slovakia and other European countries.
These services may be relevant for:
mobility recovery, musculoskeletal rehabilitation, physical conditioning, post-treatment recovery, longer-term rehabilitation, or preventive health programmes, where professionally appropriate.
A medical spa should complement appropriate healthcare — not replace medically necessary treatment.
Recovery Close to Home Travelling abroad may make sense for a specialised procedure.
Long-term rehabilitation may make more sense close to home.
Affordia can therefore help explore both international and local recovery options.
The objective is not to keep the client travelling unnecessarily.
It is to find a practical recovery pathway.
Treatment May Be International. Recovery Can Be Local.
Second Opinion After Treatment Sometimes a client wants another professional perspective after a procedure or major course of treatment.
Affordia Health can help coordinate an appropriate second opinion where available.
This may be useful when:
symptoms persist, recovery is slower than expected, the client wants another perspective, additional treatment has been recommended, or the client wants to better understand the next stage of care.
The medical opinion itself is provided by the relevant qualified professional.
Online Follow-Up Where appropriate, some follow-up consultations may be possible online.
Affordia Health can help coordinate access to:
the original healthcare provider, another specialist, a rehabilitation professional, a Chinese healthcare professional, or another appropriate provider.
Online consultation does not replace physical examination when one is medically necessary.
Recovery Is Individual Two people undergoing the same procedure may recover differently.
Recovery may depend on:
age, overall health, type of procedure, medical complexity, physical condition, existing illnesses, rehabilitation, sleep, nutrition, stress, and other individual factors.
For this reason, Affordia Health does not promise fixed recovery times.
Recovery Should Follow the Individual — Not a Generic Timeline.
Warning Signs Require Medical Attention Affordia Health is not an emergency medical service.
If a client experiences concerning symptoms during recovery, they should contact an appropriate healthcare professional or emergency service.
Depending on the procedure, warning signs may require urgent professional assessment.
Affordia local assistance may help with practical coordination where available, but it should never delay necessary emergency or medical care.
Long-Term Prevention After Treatment Recovery can also be an opportunity to reconsider longterm health.
Some medical problems involve risk factors that may continue after treatment.
Depending on the condition, qualified professionals may recommend changes concerning:
physical activity, body weight, nutrition, sleep, stress, smoking, alcohol, work habits, rehabilitation, or other modifiable factors.
But where relevant risk factors can be changed, treatment may be followed by a longer-term prevention strategy.
From Recovery to Affordia Care Clients who want continued long-term support may transition into Affordia Care.
Affordia Care is designed around:
prevention, health understanding, online consultation, lifestyle support, monitoring, professional referrals, and long-term health planning.
This creates a continuous pathway:
Treatment ↓ Recovery ↓ Rehabilitation ↓ Follow-Up ↓ Prevention ↓ Affordia Care Your Healthcare Journey Can Continue Some clients will need Affordia only for one service.
Others may want support throughout several stages of their healthcare journey.
Both are possible.
You remain free to decide which services you need.
There is no obligation to continue using Affordia after treatment.
If further support creates value for you, it can be added when needed.
Continue Only When It Helps You.
Coordination Across Providers Recovery may involve more than one organisation.
hospital, specialist, physiotherapist, rehabilitation centre, medical spa, local doctor, insurance professional, and Affordia Care.
Affordia can help coordinate the practical connections between these services where agreed.
Each professional remains responsible for their own service.
Recovery Costs Recovery services are not automatically included in the cost of treatment or other Affordia Health services.
Where additional Affordia assistance is required, services and fees are agreed separately according to our modular and pay-as-you-go model.
Healthcare and rehabilitation providers may also charge their own fees directly.
Clients remain in control of which services they choose.
Recovery Planning Where appropriate, recovery planning can begin before the client travels for treatment.
This may help answer practical questions such as:
How long might I need to stay after treatment?
Will I need assistance during the first days?
Can I travel home immediately?
Will I need rehabilitation?
Where can rehabilitation take place?
Will I need follow-up appointments?
Who will I contact after returning home?
The medical answers must come from appropriate healthcare professionals.
Affordia can help turn those answers into a practical plan.
Complete the Journey Properly Successful healthcare is not only about reaching the operating room.
It is also about what happens afterward.
Treatment is one stage.
Recovery is another.
Prevention may be the next.
Affordia Health is designed to help clients connect these stages when support is needed.

deductibles, co-payments, non-covered treatment, travel, accommodation, Affordia Health services, or other excluded expenses.
The exact division depends on the insurer and policy.
The Principle Is Simple Use available insurance coverage where it legitimately applies.
Self-fund the remaining costs where the overall journey still makes sense.
This can create another option for clients who would otherwise assume they must either receive full insurance coverage or pay for everything themselves.

A Different Perspective on Global Healthcare When people think about travelling abroad for healthcare, China may not always be the first destination that comes to mind.
We believe that is changing.

China combines one of the world's largest healthcare systems with major tertiary hospitals, highly specialised medical departments, extensive clinical experience and rapidly developing medical technology.
For international patients looking for another healthcare option, China deserves serious consideration.
Not simply because healthcare can be more affordable — but because affordability can exist alongside scale, technology, expertise and access.
A Healthcare System Built at Extraordinary Scale China provides healthcare for a population of more than one billion people.
That scale creates something that smaller healthcare systems cannot easily reproduce: enormous clinical volume.
Major Chinese hospitals and specialist departments can treat very large numbers of patients and perform substantial numbers of procedures.
For certain specialists and medical teams, this can mean extensive practical experience accumulated through repeated exposure to particular conditions and procedures.
For an international patient, the important question is therefore not simply:
Which hospital is the biggest?
It is:
Which hospital, department and medical team has the right experience for my particular case?
That is one of the questions Affordia Health helps clients explore.
Grade 3A Hospitals For hospital-based treatment, Affordia Health primarily focuses on China's Grade 3A (Tier 3A ) hospitals.
China operates a tiered hospital system, with tertiary hospitals positioned at the highest level and responsible particularly for complex, serious and difficult medical conditions.
China also applies national assessment standards to tertiary hospitals covering areas including medical quality, safety and hospital management.
But we do not believe a classification should be the end of the selection process.
Not every leading hospital is equally strong in every medical field.
One hospital may have an outstanding cardiovascular department.
Another may be particularly experienced in orthopaedics.
Another may have highly specialised oncology, neurosurgery or another clinical department.
Affordia Health therefore looks beyond the hospital classification and considers the speciality and department relevant to the individual case.
Advanced Medical Technology China is no longer simply a low-cost manufacturing economy.
It is one of the world's major technology and innovation centres — and healthcare is part of that development.
Leading Chinese hospitals increasingly operate sophisticated diagnostic, surgical, imaging and treatment infrastructure.
China's national healthcare strategy explicitly emphasises medical technology innovation, clinical research, specialised medical centres and the development of highlevel hospitals.
For patients considering treatment abroad, this creates an important combination:
Advanced infrastructure + experienced medical teams + large clinical volumes.
Experience Through Scale Medical technology matters.
But technology alone does not treat patients.
People do.
China's population and the scale of its healthcare system mean that physicians working in major specialist centres may encounter large numbers of cases throughout their careers.
In appropriate specialties, this can create significant accumulated clinical experience.
This is particularly relevant when selecting a hospital for a specialised procedure.
Affordia Health therefore does not simply ask whether a hospital offers a procedure.
We look for the most appropriate available combination of:

Hospital → Department → Specialisation → Experience → Availability → Cost → Location → Support Potentially Faster Access Waiting for healthcare can be frustrating — particularly when a person already knows that treatment may be necessary.
One reason international patients may consider China is the possibility of obtaining faster access to certain specialists, examinations or treatments than they can obtain at home.
Actual availability depends on the hospital, specialist, procedure and individual medical case.
For that reason, Affordia Health does not promise an artificial universal waiting time.
We check availability for the individual client.
When appropriate treatment can be accessed sooner, that difference can become one of the most important reasons for considering healthcare abroad.
Healthcare Designed to Remain Accessible China's healthcare system has a strong public component.
Government policy places significant emphasis on accessibility, public hospitals, medical insurance coverage and the availability of healthcare across different levels of the system.
Public hospitals remain central to healthcare delivery, while tertiary hospitals concentrate increasingly on serious, complex and difficult medical conditions.
China's basic medical insurance system covered approximately 95% of the population at the end of 2025.
The scale of public healthcare and government involvement creates a healthcare environment fundamentally different from purely private international medical markets.
International Patients Can Access Public Hospitals An important and sometimes overlooked feature of the Chinese healthcare system is that foreigners can receive treatment in Chinese public hospitals.
This creates another option beyond expensive international private hospitals.

Affordia Health helps international clients explore suitable healthcare possibilities while considering the level of hospital, relevant department, practical accessibility and available international-patient support.
Where appropriate, international or VIP services may also be considered.
The right choice depends on the individual client.
Affordable Healthcare Without Building the Journey Around Price Alone Affordability is important to us.
It is part of our name.
But Affordia Health does not believe the cheapest healthcare is automatically the best healthcare.
Treatment costs can vary significantly depending on:
the procedure, medical complexity, hospital, department, doctor, technology required, length of hospitalisation, medication, and level of additional service.
For some treatments, China may provide a substantial cost advantage compared with certain Western healthcare markets.
For others, the difference may be smaller.
That is why we prefer real information over universal percentage claims.
Where reliable information is available, we aim to help clients understand expected costs before they make their decision.
Affordable should mean better access to appropriate healthcare — not simply finding the lowest price.
Western Medicine and Traditional Chinese Medicine China also offers something unusual within global healthcare.
Modern Western medicine and Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) exist within the same broader healthcare system.
International patients may therefore have access to conventional medical treatment while also having the possibility of exploring TCM services where appropriate and desired.
Affordia Health can also help arrange consultations with qualified Chinese medical professionals, including TCM practitioners where available.
These are separate healthcare options, and clients remain free to decide what they wish to explore.
A Healthcare System That Continues to Develop China's healthcare system is not standing still.
National policy continues to focus on strengthening tertiary hospitals, specialist medical centres, regional medical capacity, clinical research, healthcare technology and access to care.
The country is simultaneously investing heavily in areas such as artificial intelligence, robotics, advanced manufacturing and digital infrastructure.
We believe the interaction between these capabilities and healthcare will continue to create new medical possibilities.
China is interesting as a healthcare destination today — and its potential may be even greater tomorrow.

Referral Terms Who Qualifies?
The Referral Program applies to new paying Affordia Health clients introduced by an eligible referrer.
A person who only contacts Affordia Health or receives a free initial consultation does not qualify as a successful referral.
The referred person must purchase and pay for an eligible Affordia Health service.
€100 Reward The standard referral reward is €100 for each qualifying new paying client.
The reward is paid once per referred client.
Purchasing multiple Affordia Health services does not create multiple referral rewards for the same referred person.
When Does a Referral Become Eligible?
A referral becomes eligible when:

the referred person is a new Affordia Health client; the referrer has been identified as the person who made the introduction; the referred client purchases an eligible Affordia Health service; and the applicable Affordia Health service fee has been successfully paid.
Free Consultations Do Not Qualify Affordia Health provides an initial consultation free of charge.
Because no paid service has been purchased, a free consultation alone does not generate a referral reward.
If that person later becomes a paying client, the referral may then qualify.
One Referrer Per Client Each new client can be attributed to one referrer.
If more than one person claims the same referral, Affordia Health may determine the applicable referrer based on the first documented introduction or referral information available to us.
Referral Rewards Are Separate From Healthcare Referral rewards relate exclusively to the introduction of new clients to Affordia Health services.
They are not payments for recommending a particular doctor, hospital, medical procedure, medication or treatment.
Healthcare decisions remain between the client and qualified healthcare professionals.
No Medical Representation Participation in the Referral Program does not authorise anyone to represent themselves as an employee, agent, medical adviser or official representative of Affordia Health.
Referrers should share only their genuine personal experience and publicly available information about Affordia Health.
Independent Client Decision Every referred person must independently decide whether Affordia Health and healthcare in China are appropriate for them.
Referrers must not pressure individuals to purchase Affordia Health services or pursue particular medical treatment.
Programme Administration Affordia Health may verify referrals and eligibility before issuing a reward.
Referral rewards are subject to the programme conditions applicable when the qualifying referral is made.
Affordia Health may update, suspend or discontinue the Referral Program where necessary, without affecting referral rewards that have already become payable under the applicable terms.
